name: audio.silence
title: Silence map
summary: Finds silences (including leading and trailing) and where speech ends in an audio or video file, using 10 ms windows and a peak threshold.
description: Decodes the first audio stream at its native rate and channel count and reports every run of near-silent 10 ms windows at least min_duration_s long, plus leading_s (a silence starting at 0), trailing_s (a silence ending at the file end) and speech_end_s (the last sample above -40 dBFS plus a 30 ms tail). Use it to trim dead air, place voice-over or find gaps. It measures; it never changes anything.

input.description: Audio or video file: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>. The first audio stream is analysed at its native rate and channel count.

threshold_db.description: A 10 ms window counts as silent when its peak absolute sample over all channels is below this dBFS level.

min_duration_s.description: Shortest silence to report, in seconds. Shorter runs are ignored.

examples.title: Silence map of a tone with gaps
